services.name: Canadian passport — regular service
services.dateLabel: When was the complete application received?
services.sourceLabel: Government of Canada — Passport processing times

variants.label: Passport office / qualifying 10-day Service Canada location
variants.nextAction: If the published service standard has passed, check the application status through the official Passport Program. Some applications can take longer when additional verification, corrections, photos or information are required.
variants.refundNote: An automatic fee remission may apply when the applicable Passport Program remission rules are met.

variants.label: Regular Service Canada location, outreach site, mail or online
variants.nextAction: If the published service standard has passed, check the application status through the official Passport Program. Mailing time is not included in the published service standard.
variants.refundNote: An automatic fee remission may apply when the applicable Passport Program remission rules are met.

services.name: Canadian passport — urgent or express pickup
services.dateLabel: When was the complete application received?
services.sourceLabel: Government of Canada — Passport service standards

variants.label: Urgent pickup
variants.standardText: By the end of the next business day
sourceChecks: end of the next business day
variants.nextAction: Use the pickup date provided by the passport officer as the primary date. If that date has passed, contact the Passport Program or the office handling the application.

variants.label: Express pickup
variants.nextAction: This estimate uses the outer end of the published 2-to-9-business-day range. Use the pickup date provided by the passport officer if one was given.

services.name: Permanent residence — economic programs
services.dateLabel: When did IRCC receive the complete PR application?

variants.label: Canadian Experience Class — Express Entry
variants.nextAction: This is IRCC's published service standard for complete Canadian Experience Class applications within the approved annual immigration levels plan. Current queue-based processing estimates can be different, so compare this result with IRCC's current processing-time tool.

variants.label: Federal Skilled Worker — Express Entry
variants.nextAction: This is IRCC's published service standard for complete Federal Skilled Worker applications within the approved annual immigration levels plan. Current queue-based processing estimates can be different, so compare this result with IRCC's current processing-time tool.

variants.label: Federal Skilled Trades — Express Entry
variants.nextAction: This is IRCC's published service standard. Current operational processing times can differ significantly from the service standard, so check IRCC's current processing-time tool before deciding whether a file is unusually delayed.

variants.label: Provincial Nominee Program — Express Entry
variants.nextAction: The 180-day federal service standard does not include processing performed by the province or territory. Check IRCC's current processing-time tool for the latest operational estimate.

variants.label: Provincial Nominee Program — non-Express Entry / paper stream
variants.nextAction: The 11-month federal standard does not include processing performed by the province or territory. Check IRCC's current processing-time tool because the live estimate can be longer or shorter.

variants.label: Quebec-selected skilled worker
variants.nextAction: This federal standard excludes the provincial selection stage. Compare the result with IRCC's current processing-time tool for the live estimate.

services.name: Permanent residence — spouse, partner or dependent child overseas
services.dateLabel: When did IRCC receive the complete PR application?
services.sourceLabel: IRCC — Family Class Priority service standard

variants.label: Overseas spouse, partner or dependent child
variants.nextAction: IRCC's service standard is 12 months for complete overseas Family Class priority applications. This does not apply to every family sponsorship stream; current operational processing times may differ.

services.name: Permanent resident card — first card
services.dateLabel: When was permanent residence confirmed and the PR card form completed?

variants.label: First PR card after becoming a permanent resident
variants.nextAction: The published standard is 60 days after confirming permanent residence and completing the required form at a port of entry or IRCC inland office. Check IRCC's current processing-time tool for current operations.

services.name: Canadian citizenship grant
services.dateLabel: When did IRCC receive the complete application?

variants.label: Citizenship grant — adult or minor
variants.nextAction: IRCC's published service standard for citizenship grants is 12 months. Check the current processing-time tool and your application status before treating a file as unusually delayed.

services.name: Work permit
services.dateLabel: When did IRCC receive the complete application?

variants.label: Initial work permit from outside Canada — excluding IEC
sourceChecks: Initial work permits from outside Canada
variants.nextAction: The published service standard is 60 days for complete initial work permit applications from outside Canada, excluding International Experience Canada. Current processing estimates vary by country and application type.

variants.label: Work permit extension from inside Canada
sourceChecks: Work permit extensions from in Canada
variants.nextAction: The published service standard is 120 days. Check IRCC's current processing-time tool because operational processing times can differ.

variants.label: International Experience Canada work permit
variants.nextAction: The published IEC service standard is 56 days or less for complete applications. IRCC may exclude certain periods from service-standard calculations, including some time related to required biometrics or medical information.

services.name: Study permit
services.dateLabel: When did IRCC receive the complete application?

variants.label: New study permit from outside Canada
sourceChecks: New study permit applications submitted outside Canada
variants.nextAction: The published service standard is 60 days for complete new study permit applications submitted outside Canada. Current processing estimates vary and should be checked separately.

variants.label: New permit or extension from inside Canada
variants.nextAction: The published service standard is 120 days for complete study permit applications submitted in Canada, including extensions. Check IRCC's live processing-time tool for current operations.

services.name: Visitor visa or super visa
services.dateLabel: When did IRCC receive the complete application?

variants.label: New visitor visa from outside Canada
sourceChecks: New visitor visa applications submitted outside Canada
variants.nextAction: The published service standard is 14 days, but current operational processing times can differ substantially by country. Check IRCC's current processing-time tool.

variants.label: Parent or grandparent super visa from outside Canada
variants.nextAction: The published service standard is 112 days for complete new super visa applications submitted outside Canada. Check IRCC's current processing-time tool for the live estimate.

services.name: Restoration of temporary resident status
services.dateLabel: When did IRCC receive the complete request?

variants.label: Restoration of temporary resident status
variants.nextAction: The published service standard is five months for complete restoration requests. Individual files can take longer when additional review is required.

services.name: Employment Insurance — regular benefits decision
services.dateLabel: When did you file the EI application?
services.sourceLabel: Government of Canada — EI regular benefits after you apply

variants.label: EI regular benefits
variants.nextAction: The service standard is to provide a decision within 28 days of filing. Missing Records of Employment or other required information can delay processing. Check My Service Canada Account for claim status and messages.

services.name: Social Insurance Number — online application
services.dateLabel: When was the complete SIN application received?
services.sourceLabel: Government of Canada — SIN online application

variants.label: Online SIN application
variants.nextAction: Service Canada states that an online SIN application is processed within five business days, with a response provided by mail within 10 business days from receipt. This estimate tracks the processing portion, not postal delivery.

services.name: Complaint to a federally regulated bank
services.dateLabel: When did you first make the complaint to the bank?
services.sourceLabel: Financial Consumer Agency of Canada — Bank complaint rights

variants.label: Complaint to a federally regulated bank
sourceChecks: Ombudsman for Banking Services and Investments
variants.nextAction: A federally regulated bank must provide a detailed written response within 56 calendar days from when you first made the complaint. You may contact OBSI on the earlier of more than 56 calendar days since filing, or after the bank provides its detailed written response and closes the complaint.

services.name: Federal access to information / personal information request
services.dateLabel: When did the federal institution receive the complete request?
services.sourceLabel: Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat — How ATIP requests work

variants.label: Access to Information Act request
variants.standardText: 30 calendar days, subject to permitted extensions
variants.nextAction: Federal institutions generally have 30 calendar days to respond. A permitted extension can apply, and you should be notified when an extension is taken. If the calculated date falls on a weekend or federal holiday, this estimate moves it to the next working day.

variants.label: Privacy Act personal information request
variants.standardText: 30 calendar days, subject to permitted extensions
variants.nextAction: Federal institutions generally have 30 calendar days to respond. Privacy Act requests may be extended in specified circumstances, so check any extension notice before treating the request as overdue.

services.name: CRA individual tax return — T1
services.dateLabel: When did CRA receive the return?

variants.label: Digital — on-time standard individual return
variants.nextAction: CRA's 2026–27 service standard is to issue a notice of assessment within two weeks for qualifying on-time digital T1 returns. Several return types and files requiring more information are excluded.

variants.label: Paper — on-time standard individual return
variants.nextAction: CRA's 2026–27 service standard is to issue a notice of assessment within 12 weeks for qualifying on-time paper T1 returns. Several return types and files requiring more information are excluded.

services.name: CRA T1 adjustment request — routine
services.dateLabel: When did CRA receive the adjustment request?

variants.label: Digital routine adjustment
variants.nextAction: CRA's 2026–27 service standard for a routine digital T1 adjustment is two weeks. Complex requests or files requiring additional review can take longer.

variants.label: Paper or telephone routine adjustment
variants.nextAction: CRA's 2026–27 service standard for a routine paper or telephone T1 adjustment is eight weeks. CRA's current operational processing time can be different from the published service standard.

services.name: Corporations Canada — incorporation
services.dateLabel: When did Corporations Canada receive the complete filing?

variants.label: Online incorporation
variants.nextAction: Corporations Canada's current service commitment for online incorporation is one business day. Check the filing status or contact Corporations Canada if the published commitment has passed.

variants.label: Email or mail incorporation
variants.nextAction: Corporations Canada's current service commitment for incorporation submitted by email or mail is 10 business days.
